sources.termsSummary: The supplied licence states that the ranges are free for personal study and play, prohibits commercial use without written permission, and directs permission requests to ART/GTO support.
sources.notes: Do not publish or deploy these source ranges. Confirm with ART/GTO whether local integration into PokerLab for personal use is covered.
